results.title: What's Going on With UnitedHealth Stock?
UnitedHealth Group Incorporated (UNH) Stock Price, News, Quote & History

summary: UNH stock up ~34.6% over the past month driven by strong Q1 2026 earnings beat. Goldman Sachs added UNH to Conviction List with $435 target. Company raised 2026 revenue and earnings guidance. Shares traded in range $364.65-$370.83 on May 4. UNH increased premiums to offset higher medical costs. CEO Stephen Hemsley (returned May 2025) leading turnaround.
